title: Book Translator input
description: Upload one supported book and choose the target language. The LLM credentials and model selection are controlled by the Actor owner.

bookFiles.title: Book file
bookFiles.description: Upload one EPUB, HTML/XHTML, Markdown, or TXT book.

sourceUrl.title: Book URL
sourceUrl.description: Alternative to file upload: a direct HTTP(S) URL to the source book.

targetLanguage.title: Target language
targetLanguage.description: Target language name or code, for example Russian or ru.

sourceLanguage.title: Source language
sourceLanguage.description: Optional override. Leave empty to use source metadata or unknown.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Build EPUB, Markdown, or both after every chapter has current PASS review evidence.

maxLlmCostUsd.title: Optional LLM cost ceiling
maxLlmCostUsd.description: Optional lower ceiling for this run in whole USD. The owner-level hard ceiling still applies.
